s: homeland, domestic territory (as opposed to a foreign country)
Das deutsche Strafrecht gilt für Taten, die im Inland begangen werden.
The German criminal law applies for acts committed in the domestic territory [of Germany].
inland (areas more or less remote from a border, especially from the coast)
rare
Inland.et: 19th century, from in- + Land, a back-formation from Ausland as well as from older Inländer, inländisch (themselves backformations from Ausländer, ausländisch).

s: friendly to natives
native, resident, national (male or of unspecified gender)
domestic, internal (not foreign)
of late; lately; recently; referring to the recent past as a whole
rollerblade; in-line skate
rollerblade; in-line skate
to rollerblade, to inline skate
intransitive
inlinern.et: Derived from Inliner, itself from Inlineskate.

s: the fabric of a pillow or duvet, which is filled with the downs, etc., and sewn up
Inlett.et: 16th century, from Middle Low German inlēde, probably from inlēden (“to insert, fix in, send in”), equivalent to German einleiten. In modern Low German also Inlaat, from Middle Low German inlāten, equivalent to German einlassen, with more or less the same mean…

s: inlaut, the position of a sound in the middle of a word
domestic flight
domestic intelligence service
domestic purchasing power (the value of a currency expressed in terms of the amount of goods and services that one unit of money can buy within the country's own borders)
Die sinkende Inlandskaufkraft infolge der Inflation dämpft den privaten Konsum.
The falling domestic purchasing power as a result of inflation dampens private consumption.
Maßnahmen zur Stärkung der Inlandskaufkraft sind entscheidend für die Stabilität des Einzelhandels.
Measures to strengthen domestic purchasing power are crucial for the stability of the retail sector.
domestic payment transactions (the movement of money between bank accounts within the same country)
Für den Inlandszahlungsverkehr gelten oft einheitliche Gebührensätze.
Uniform fee rates often apply to domestic payment transactions.
Die Bank hat ihre Systeme für den nationalen Inlandszahlungsverkehr optimiert.
The bank has optimized its systems for national domestic payment traffic.
Inlandszahlungsverkehr.et: From Inland (“domestic country, home country”) + -s- + Zahlungsverkehr (“payment transactions”).
